Klasse Colors

java.lang.Object
treptowkolleg.plot.Colors
public abstract class Colors extends Object
A centralized collection of predefined, application-specific Color constants for consistent and semantic visual styling across the plot framework.

Colors are grouped by hue and semantic intent (e.g., alert colors like RED, success indicators like GREEN, and neutral UI grays like GRAY5). All colors are defined using RGB values and are immutable by convention.

This class is designed to be used statically, e.g.: 

g.setColor(Colors.BLUE);
label.setForeground(Colors.DARKER_GREEN);
